valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Prolonged housing/DIY softness and raw material cost pressure compress Paint Stores Group margins

base.driver: Steady Paint Stores Group same-store sales (~4%) and gradual margin recovery off FY2026E $12.00 midpoint

bull.driver: Stronger commercial/residential repainting volume and operating leverage

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $13.35, the $349.89 close implies 26.2x; at 26.5x, the close implies $13.20 EPS.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $13.35 (3.8 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Paint Stores Group same-store sales growth (3.9% YoY in Q3 2026) and segment profit margin (24.3% in Q3 2026).

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings on October 27, 2026, named analysts largely trimmed price targets (Citi to $370 from $400, RBC to $383 from $392, JPMorgan to $375 from $380) while maintaining Buy/Outperform/Overweight ratings, whereas UBS raised its target to $370 from $363 with a Neutral rating. Other firms without attributed analyst names in our sources (DA Davidson $390, Guggenheim $375, Barclays $329) also cut targets post-earnings. The ~$374.50 average of the four named targets sits ~6 pp above our $353.78 base case, which would require ~28.1x our $13.35 base EPS or ~$14.13 EPS at 26.5x.
